anchors.quote: We remain confident of achieving revenues in the range of INR 875 to INR 950 crore in FY27 on a standalone basis, considering full production from MPP-5.
Dahej Phase 1 project is budgeted at INR 428 crore and is firmly on track for completion by February 2027.
revised cost for Pakhajan Phase 2 stands at INR 1,367 crore and expected completion is by March 2027.
Commercial manufacturing for electrolyte remains targeted for H1 FY27, while electrolyte salts are expected in H2 FY27.
We are on track to commission both, the Dahej and Pakhajan plants, within the current financial year, FY27.

received provisional approval from additional global customers for lithium electrolyte salts; final site audits for multiple US-based electrolyte makers completed and awaiting final commercial clearances.
improving demand visibility for India's giga-scale ACC battery manufacturing ecosystem, alongside strong international interest for non-FEOC compliant supply chain.
EBITDA margin sustained at 17.8% despite expansion-related overheads, geopolitical-led supply chain disruptions, and temporary costs associated with Dahej replacement facility.
Their planned equity contribution of $20 million towards the joint venture is expected during H1 FY27.

triggers: Dahej replacement plant commissioning by Feb 2027 — stabilizes standalone operations and eliminates toll manufacturing drag
Pakhajan electrolyte manufacturing start (H1 FY27) — first major battery materials revenue inflection; critical for process stabilization and customer qualification
Pakhajan electrolyte salts production ramp (H2 FY27) — completion of full product portfolio; unlocks transition from pilot to regular commercial supplies
Final US electrolyte maker commercial clearances — multiple site audits complete; high-margin export revenue stream validation
Morita $20 million equity infusion in H1 FY27 — confirms joint venture funding and de-risks Pakhajan execution
FY27 revenue realization within ₹875–950 cr guidance — validates capex project execution and end-market demand absorption (pharma, F&F, battery materials)

outlook.summary: Neogen enters FY27 at transformational inflection with dual catalysts: Dahej commissioning (Feb 2027) normalizes legacy standalone business, while Pakhajan's H1–H2 ramp of electrolyte and salts unlocks India's first non-FEOC battery materials platform.
